reviews.review:
I had hopes for Antivirus PROTOCOL to become more interesting than the demo I played a couple months ago. The full release still feels like a demo.

The skill tree is nearly a straight line requiring level completion to continue with no interesting choices to make. The gameplay loop has three stages. You start by hovering directly over enemies. Then you kite green enemies. Then you look for blue enemies along the edge. There's only one boss shared across every 15 levels, and there's no other real way to approach the game with its limited system. 

There are a couple levels that are huge walls due to bad scaling. All other games I've played like this allow you to go back to a previous level, but this Antivirus PROTOCOL locks you into the new level. So, you end up spending several minutes grinding a handful of enemies until you build enough currency to finally get back into the linear progression.

Honestly, I just can't find any reason I would recommend this game to someone.
